A decensor of Muunyan's Kyokutou Kenran Tobakutou Dream Island - Miyamoto Musashi Hen
As a note most of the images are made up from their Fanbox page which have higher resolutions and less black bars along with small changes speech bubble placements. The images on their Fanbox range from 2598 x 3626 to 5197 x 7252 with pages 27 onwards only being released at 1814 x 2523. In this gallery all the images have been resized to 1814 x 2523 but Im including a zip with all of them decensored at their native resolutions.
